nodes.description: A desolate four-way junction choked in grey grit, flanked by a shattered watchtower and a shallow ford across the Ashen Water. Exits lead north into the burnt barrens, south toward the crossing ford, east into the brush of Thorwood, and west along the rutted trade road.

A low-ceilinged common room thick with peat smoke and sour tallow. Stained oak tables crowd around an ash-choked hearth. A doorway leads back toward the kitchen, while a narrow timber stair climbs into the darkness of the upper rooms.
A cramped stone kitchen hot with coal grease. An iron kettle rattles over an open hearth. A back door bolts against the alley mud, smelling of brine and boiled turnips.

A low, sagging tavern built from ship timbers and blackened brick. Bitter pipe smoke hangs thick under rotting rafters. A stone fireplace smolders with dry peat. Two exits lead out: the heavy street door facing east, and a low arched doorway in the rear leading down a damp corridor toward the cellar and back alley.

A cramped stone scullery reeking of salt cod and burnt tallow. A narrow hearth flickers against soot-stained stone. An iron grease-barrel stands near a low oak timber back door opening to the alley mud.

A low-ceilinged parlour smelling of cold ashes and damp plaster. A stone hearth sits dark against the north wall. A grime-streaked glass window looks southeast onto the muddy street. An open doorway leads west into the central passage.

m: The Deserter's Coin + Track Malcor and recover the stolen pay chest
The Deserter's Coin + Interrogate the scavengers at the crossing
Sub: The Swan and Raven — Kitchen

steering: (We are here: the crossroads tied to Gockbridge, p2)
I leave the scavenger to his mule and walk on into Gockbridge. I push through the door of The White Raven and look for the landlord.
I nod to the landlord and walk straight through to the inn's kitchen to find the cook.
I thank the cook, leave The White Raven and cross the street to The Swan and Raven.
I walk straight through the taproom and into this inn's kitchen, looking for whoever runs it.
I leave the Swan and Raven, cross back to The White Raven and go straight to its kitchen again — I want another word with Edric the cook.
I step out of the kitchen into the parlour and take a seat by the window to wait for Edric.
